title: Log structures

# Log structures

# Introduction

Log structures require Corewood and the proximity of a Workbench to be built and repaired.

## Common properties

Log structures share the following properties:

• Property: Durability | Value: 400

• Property: Support | Value: Hard Wood (from 10 to 140)

• Property: Loss | Value: 1/10 vertical, 1/6 horizontal

• Property: Resistances | Value: Weak: Chop Neutral: Blunt, Slash, Pickaxe, Fire, Frost, Lightning Resistant: Pierce Immune: Poison, Spirit

### Poles and beams

• Structure: Log pole 2m | Materials: Corewood x1 | Size: 2x1 | Damaged by rain: Yes

• Structure: Log pole 4m | Materials: Corewood x2 | Size: 4x1 | Damaged by rain: Yes

• Structure: Log beam 2m | Materials: Corewood x1 | Size: 2x1 | Damaged by rain: Yes

• Structure: Log beam 4m | Materials: Corewood x2 | Size: 4x1 | Damaged by rain: Yes

• Structure: Log beam 45° | Materials: Corewood x1 | Size: 2x1 | Damaged by rain: No

• Structure: Log beam 26° | Materials: Corewood x1 | Size: 2x1 | Damaged by rain: No
